# Anoop Sinkaran
**Senior Automation QA Engineer | Quality Assurance Lead**  
Blacktown NSW, Australia • 0406 295 160 • ns.anoop@gmail.com • linkedin.com/in/anoop-sinkaran

---

### Professional Summary
Quality Assurance professional with over 19 years of software testing experience, specializing in end-to-end test automation, framework enhancement, and converting complex requirements into robust test suites. Demonstrated expertise utilizing Playwright, JavaScript, TypeScript, and C# to design, maintain, and optimize automated regression scripts across web and distributed platforms. Collaborative engineering partner skilled in manual test analysis, defect triage, and integrating automated quality gates within CI/CD pipelines to drive reliable software delivery.

---

### Core Competencies & Technical Skills

* **Test Automation & Tools:** Playwright, Selenium WebDriver, Android Espresso, iOS XCUITest, Robolectric
* **Testing Methodologies:** Automated Script Development, Manual Test Case Design, Manual-to-Automated Test Conversion, Regression Testing, End-to-End Testing, Defect Triage & Management, Release Management
* **Languages & Technologies:** JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, C#, Java, Kotlin, SQL, .NET, React, UNIX Shell Scripting
* **CI/CD & Version Control:** Azure DevOps Pipelines, GitHub Actions, GitHub, Git
* **Test Strategy & Agile Tools:** Agile/Scrum, JIRA, Zephyr, TestRail, HP ALM
* **Observability & Code Quality:** Dynatrace, Mobile Security Framework (MobSF), GitHub Copilot Tools

---

### Professional Experience

**Wpay (Woolworths Group)** | Sydney, Australia  
*Senior Quality Engineer* | November 2021 – Present  
* Developed and maintained an end-to-end automation suite using **Playwright** covering gift card activation and redemption workflows, converting manual test procedures into reliable automated scripts to accelerate regression cycles.
* Analyzed business specifications and technical documentation in a dual BA/QA capacity to create detailed user stories, manual test cases, and edge-case validation criteria for a terminal onboarding and licensing gateway.
* Engineered Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines to automate API Gateway regression suites and integrated Mobile Security Framework (MobSF) for static vulnerability scanning across builds.
* Designed custom GitHub Copilot automation workflows and automated PR reviews to identify breaking changes, optimize script execution, and eliminate coverage gaps before release.
* Formulated comprehensive test strategies, documentation, and pilot validation programs to verify card payment message structures and failure modes prior to production deployment.
* Executed unit and component-level automation using Robolectric and AI-assisted tooling to expand test coverage across Coroutines, ViewModels, and Activities.
* Automated native mobile functional regression suites across iOS and Android platforms utilizing XCUITest and Espresso.

**DX Solutions** | Sydney, Australia  
*Senior Quality Engineer* | June 2021 – September 2021  
* Delivered quality assurance strategies and automated testing support across client enterprise web applications to validate business-critical workflows.
* Collaborated with cross-functional development teams to troubleshoot test script failures, update test artifacts, and maintain test execution consistency.

**Avant Mutual** | Sydney, Australia  
*QA Lead / Senior Automation Test Analyst* | April 2019 – April 2021  
* Led QA testing initiatives for an enterprise platform migration from a legacy LAMP stack to a modern cloud-native .NET and React application, ensuring end-to-end data integrity.
* Directed daily defect triage meetings, cross-functional alignment sessions, and release sign-offs with development and product stakeholders to maintain release quality gates.
* Authored and reviewed comprehensive test cases derived from functional specifications to validate complex cloud business workflows.

**Seven West Media** | Sydney, Australia  
*Developer in Test* | September 2018 – April 2019  
* Formulated automated testing frameworks for digital media publishing platforms, reducing manual testing effort and streamlining sprint delivery cycles.
* Partnered with software engineers to convert sprint acceptance criteria into executable automated checks within Agile iterations.

**SmartClinics** | Sydney, Australia  
*Quality Assurance Analyst* | January 2018 – August 2018  
* Converted functional business specifications into structured manual test cases and automated regression suites using C#, expanding coverage across core clinical workflows.
* Led sprint testing activities, conducted comprehensive regression runs, and logged and tracked software defects to resolution in JIRA.

**Cubic Transportation Systems (Client: Transport For NSW)** | Sydney, Australia  
*System Test Engineer* | August 2016 – January 2018  
* Managed test planning, manual test case documentation, and end-to-end test execution for the Opal Travel ticketing platform.
* Verified functional requirements and system integrations against technical specifications to ensure software compliance.

**EMC / Tata Consultancy Services / Wipro / Accenture** | India
